settings.help:
This setting determines if End of Manufacturing will be triggered on first boot of the platform after flashing.
Note: When this setting is enabled Intel(R) CSME will enter End of Manufacturing regardless of the descriptor settings.
settings.label: EOM on First Boot Enabled
settings.name: EomFirstBootEnabled_eom_config

settings.help:
This setting deteremines which settings will be automatically commited during End of Manufacturing flows.
Note: The FPFs, RPMB / RPMC and set manufacturing mode settings are mandatory and cannot be overridden revenue parts. Simulation can be done on non-revenue part with the Hardware binding set to disabled.
settings.label: Flexible EOM setting options
settings.name: FlexibleEomSettings
options: Do not lock Descriptor and OEM Configs

settings.help:
This setting determines if End of Manufacturing will be triggered on first boot of the platform after flashing.
Note: When this setting is enabled Intel(R) CSME will enter End of Manufacturing regardless of the descriptor settings.
settings.label: EOM on First Boot Enabled
settings.name: EomFirstBootEnabled_eom

settings.help: Defines the 8-bits MCTP address and 7-bits SMBus address of the EC on SMLink0 or SMLink0b or eSPI bus. This value is needed if EC is using the MCTP protocol. The SMBus (LS byte) must be from 0x01 to 0x7f (and should not overlap with any SMBus address in PCH Strap 11).  The EID (MS byte) must be outside 0x01 through 0x07.
settings.label: MCTP EC Address
settings.name: MctpEcAddress

settings.help: Debug feature for pre-production platforms only, can be edited only via the config XML. If enabled, access blockers in IS and PS are enabled, and FW is read from IMR. Must be enabled for FW authentication flow and execution of authenticated FW.
settings.label: FW Secure Mode
settings.name: FWSecureMode

settings.help: This NVAR enables/disables the camera privacy. Enabling this NVAR means that the Camera privacy GPIO Pin value is used to mask/unmask all cameras' data from being used
settings.label: Camera privacy feature control disabled
settings.name: PrivacyFeatureControlDisabled

settings.help: This setting allows customers to hide the Firmware Update option in the MEBx interface.
settings.label: Hide MEBx Firmware Update Control
settings.name: HideMEBxFwUpdCtrl

settings.help: This setting allows the customer to configure the powerwell that will be used by Intel(R) Integrated LAN.  Note: Recommended setting is SLP_LAN#.
settings.label: LAN Power Well
settings.name: MELanPowerWell

settings.help: This setting allow the customer to configure the powerwell that will be used by Intel(R) wireless lan. note: recommended setting is slp_wlan#
settings.label: WLAN Power Well
settings.name: MEWlanPowerWell

settings.label: Intel(R) Remote Platform Erase supported
settings.name: RPESupported

NO = No support for vPro dock solution
settings.label: vPro Over Thunderbolt Dock State

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable the Fast identity online device onboarding (FIDO) state of the firmware.
settings.label: Fast identity online device onboarding state
settings.name: FidoSupported

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable the Wireless LAN CLINK signal through Intel(R) ME firmware.  Note: For using Intel(R) vPro Wireless solutions this should be set to Yes.
settings.label: Intel(R) ME CLINK Signal Enabled

settings.help: This setting determines processor type to be emulated on pre-production silicon.

settings.help:
This setting allows customers to disable Intel(R) AMT on the platform.
Note: Either Intel(R) AMT or Intel(R) ISM can be enabled as manageability application
settings.label: Intel(R) AMT Supported
settings.name: AmtSupported

settings.help:
Intel(R) Standard Manageability is a manageability mode that supports a subset of the Intel(R) Active Management Technology (Intel(R) AMT).
Note: Either Intel(R) AMT or Intel(R) ISM can be enabled as manageability application
settings.label: Intel(R) Standard Manageability
settings.name: ISMSupported

settings.help: This setting allows customers to permenantly disable Intel(R) AMT and Standard Manageability mode on the platform.
settings.label: Manageability Application Supported
settings.name: MngAppSupported

settings.help: This setting allows customers to determine the power up state for Intel(R) AMT or Standard Manageability.  Note: If this setting is disabled Intel(R) AMT or Standard Manageability can still be re-enabled through the MEBx interface.
settings.label: Manageability Application initial power-up state
settings.name: MngAppPowerUpState

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable the KVM Redirection capabilities of the firmware.  Note: If this setting have been set to disabled it cannot be re-enabled once the descriptor has been locked.
settings.label: KVM Redirection Supported
settings.name: KvmSupported

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable firmware Transport Layer Security support.  Note: If this is disabled TLS will be permanently disabled in the firmware image.
settings.label: Transport Layer Security Crypto Support
settings.name: TlsCryptoSupport

settings.help: This setting allows customers to determine the power up state for ISH.

settings.help: This setting permanently disables Intel(R) PTT in the firmware image.

settings.help: This setting determines if Intel(R) PTT is enabled on platform power-up.
settings.label: Intel(R) PTT initial power-up state
settings.name: PttPwrUpState

settings.help: This setting allows customers to configure the Privacy and Security level for redirection operations.  Default enables all redirection ports (User consent is configurable).  Enhanced enables all redirection ports (User consent is required and cannot be disabled).  Extreme disables all redirection capabilities.
settings.label: Redirection Privacy / Security Level
settings.name: RedirectionPrivSecLevel

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable the Intel (R) ME firmware to trigger an automatic platform reset if either the MEI or Agent Presence are in a hung state.  Note: This feature only allows one reset at a time when the watchdog expires.  After this feature has triggered a reset it must be re-armed for re-use via management console.
settings.label: Watchdog Automatic Reset Enabled
settings.name: AmtWdAutoReset

settings.help: This setting configures the idle timeout value before Manageability app enters into an off state.

settings.help:
This setting configures the FPF Hardware and RPMC / RPMB binding behavior for the platform image.
If this setting is enabled FPF Hardware and RPMC / RPMB binding behavior will occur when platform close manufacturing flow is executed with Intel(R) FPT. 
If this setting is disabled FPF Hardware and RPMC / RPMB binding behavior will not take place when close manufacturing flow is executed.
Note: For Revenue parts this setting will be ignored and FPF Hardware and RPMC / RPMB binding behavior will take place when close manufacturing flow is executed.
settings.label: Hardware Binding Enabled
settings.name: HwBindingEn

settings.help: Allows the OEM to control FW features to assist with pre-production platform debugging.  This control has no effect if used on production silicon.  Note: Certain options will do not work when the descriptor is locked (See FW Bring-up Guide for setting details).  Important: Due to an HW issue, this setting should be set temporarily to 0x400107 to prevent boot issues.
settings.label: Debug Override Pre-Production Silicon
settings.name: DbgOverridePreProdSi
